notes: Fourteen ranks ordered low to high. Unlike Samurai's retainer ladder, mounted privilege and the new lance-charge bonus arrive together at Knight Bachelor, the first true knighthood, so the faction's own cavalry unit carries the theme from its first rank up.

ranks.title: Page
ranks.description: Household child in training. Not yet armed.

ranks.title: Squire
ranks.description: Knight's attendant, permitted to bear arms in practice.

ranks.title: Man-at-Arms
ranks.description: Professional soldier under contract. Armed and armored, but unknighted.

ranks.title: Knight Errant
ranks.description: Landless knight proven in the field. Leads other soldiers on a commander's word.

ranks.title: Knight Bachelor
ranks.description: The ordinary knight. Mounted for war, and rides down a broken line.

ranks.title: Knight Banneret
ranks.description: Entitled to raise a square banner and lead its retinue in the field.

ranks.title: Baronet
ranks.description: Hereditary knight, mounted at all times, seat confirmed by charter.

ranks.title: Baron
ranks.description: Lowest of the peerage. Holds a keep and its garrison in his own right.

ranks.title: Viscount
ranks.description: Deputy to a count. Wardens a march keep and its garrison.

ranks.title: Count
ranks.description: Rules a county from its castle. Commands every garrison within it.

ranks.title: Marquess
ranks.description: Warden of the border march, the crown's first line of defense.

ranks.title: Duke
ranks.description: Sovereign of a duchy. Answers to the crown alone.

ranks.title: Prince
ranks.description: Blood of the crown. Commands armies in the king's name.

ranks.title: King
ranks.description: The crown itself. Commands the entire military.

privilegeRules.mounted: 'war' grants +1 Movement while any enemy is within 6 hexes; 'always' grants +1 Movement unconditionally.
privilegeRules.commandRadiusBonus: Added to the unit's command radius for auras and morale recovery.
privilegeRules.banner: Platoon members inside command radius recover +5 additional Morale in the Command Phase.
privilegeRules.castle: Allies inside command radius standing on Fortification gain a further +100 DEF.
privilegeRules.chargeBonus: +ATK once the unit has moved at least 2 hexes this activation without the charge breaking on rough ground (see `chargeMoved`). Stacks with, but is smaller and always-on unlike, the one-shot Charge Bonus card skill.
privilegeRules.supreme: Reserved for campaign scale; not used in the vertical slice.
